name: Holds GuardDuty Finding
description: A GuardDuty detector holds one of its active findings (detector -> finding): a finding id guardduty:ListFindings returned for the detector, filtered to unarchived findings of the run's own account, most severe first, and capped. Containment: the detector declares it in CONTAINMENT_EDGES. Its one surface per detector records the filter with no positive control and any truncation at the cap, so it is never complete and never nominates a retirement. Collected by the landing-zone reader's findings half (collectors/boto3_collector/findings.py, aws-core-tap#76).
